styleLock.direction: clean premium womens basics apparel commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio paper white #FFFFFF for the packshot, benefit and commute screens, flat cool mist-blue paper #E7EBF0 for the overhead colorway row and the styling grid, deep ink #1B222B panel fields only inside the three-band detail macro screen; flat low-contrast surfaces, no gradient, no storefront lettering
styleLock.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced cool studio light around 5600K, large front-left softbox key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft low-contrast shadows that always keep a contact shadow grounding the garment; low skimming sweep light only inside the macro band to read the knit face
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama for on-body screens, matte mist-blue paper counter for the overhead flat row, smooth pale plaster-like plane for the single hard-shadow styling panel
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, headline plus at most three short callouts, hairline leader rules, never dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line marks only, one accent #BE8A8F used solely as a short underline bar beneath a callout
styleLock.presentationRules: the garment always shows the neckline, both sleeve lengths and the side seam silhouette; on-body screens crop the body above the collarbone so no face is ever carried; scale and centering of the worn piece stay stable across the set
noDrift: no identifiable model face or celebrity likeness
no invented fabric weights, percentages, measurements or test figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womens-basics apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, cool mist-blue #E7EBF0, deep ink #1B222B and one accent #BE8A8F; cool daylight-balanced studio lighting around 5600K with a large front-left softbox key, bounce fill and soft low-contrast contact shadows that always ground the garment; matte seamless paper cyclorama and flat mist-blue paper surfaces only; modern geometric sans-serif with hairline leader rules and never dense body copy; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; garment always shown with readable neckline, both sleeve lengths and side seam, worn by a generic faceless body cropped above the collarbone; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.whitespace: even clean margin all round, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: Ghost-mannequin e-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Five identical crew-neck long-sleeve base layers arranged as one clean diagonal overlapping fan running from the upper left to the lower right, each piece shown from shoulders to hem with both sleeves settled naturally, photographed straight-on at eye level with no silhouette clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio light from a large front-left softbox with a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft low-contrast shadows only where one garment overlaps the next, every hem kept grounded. Seamless studio paper white background #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even clean margin all round and no extra whitespace. Negative: no model, no hands, no face, no hang tag lettering, no wordmark, no folded stack, no floating sleeve without an overlap shadow, no clipped garment edges, no gradient background, no text, no watermark.

shots.background: deep ink panel fields #1B222B separated by hairline paper-white gutters #FFFFFF
shots.whitespace: minimal, the fabric runs to the panel edges
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro detail screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three stacked horizontal panels of equal height separated by hairline paper-white gutters #FFFFFF, each an extreme close-up macro with a tight zoom, shallow depth of field and a sharp foreground: the top panel frames the ribbed crew neckline where it meets the shoulder seam, the middle panel frames the sleeve cuff and the knit face falling in soft folds, the bottom panel frames the hem where the fabric is drawn taut so the recovery of the weave reads on its own. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated garment parts repeated across panels, no hands touching or covering the fabric, no face, no added loose threads or stitching that the reference does not show, no invented fabric composition percentages or weight figures, no text labels inside the panels, no watermark.

One large upper panel above three equal lower panels, each showing the same crew-neck long-sleeve base layer worn a different way, alone, tucked, and beneath one plain open outer layer, every figure a generic faceless body cropped above the collarbone or turned away with the head outside the frame, all panels photographed straight-on at eye level with matched horizon lines and three-quarter length crops so no panel repeats another. Hard directional key light skimming a plain surface to throw one crisp diagonal shadow across the large upper panel, cool 5600K fill in the three inset panels so every colorway stays true and the shadow logic never contradicts itself across the grid. Pale mist-blue paper field #E7EBF0 behind the whole grid, with a slim open headline band reading 「{selling_point_2}」 in deep ink #1B222B sitting across the centre gutter. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 为多件同款按对角扇形叠放的白底主图（886x1024 竖幅）；02 为模特正面微侧、双手插腰裤袋的浅灰上衣棚拍（788x1024）；03 为模特穿黑色上衣侧身迈步、斜挎包的动态棚拍；04 为模特居左、右侧三条水平引线指向三行英文卖点（1024x918 横幅）；05 为麻灰上衣叉腰站姿半身棚拍；06 为三段等高分格微距拼图，分别拍领口、袖身手感、下摆拉扯，标签下有浅紫红色短下划线；07 为一大格硬光投影造型主片加三格不同搭配小片的造型矩阵，中部有英文标题条。品类判定依据：全部图为女式贴身圆领长袖基础上衣，按图判为女装/上衣，leaf 取到女式修身圆领长袖基础衫多件装；源图未提供可核验成分与克重，图内主张一律不采信。变体闸门结论：仅 01 一件属多色叠放陈列，02 至 07 是六种互不相同的构图与分镜，具备独立可复用分镜体系，故不判为变体画廊，正常转化。已剥离内容：原店铺与品牌字标、吊牌与包装字样、模特身份与面容（全部改为领骨以上裁切的无面部generic body）、04 与 06 与 07 的图内英文原句、原平台店铺字样、任何平台徽章与星条角标；面料克重、成分比例、保暖等级等事实一律不写入，改以空白参数位与空卖点槽承载。
